blocks.text: B1-05 · The liabilities
Lesson overview

The Arab passive is invisible: ⁧كتب⁩ may be ⁧كَتَبَ⁩ It has written: ⁧كُتِبَ⁩ It has been written, and the difference lies in the vowels that the newspapers do not write. Yet passiveness is everywhere in the language of information: ⁧يُقَالُ إِنَّ⁩ It is said that, ⁧يُعْتَقَدُ أَنَّ⁩ ... it is considered that, ⁧عُثِرَ عَلَى⁩ It has been found to be in the form of: ⁧تَمَّ افْتِتَاحُ⁩ It has been inaugurated. In this unit you learn to form the internal passive of all forms, to recognize it without vowels, to use alternative newspaper constructions ( ⁧تَمَّ⁩ + maṣdar) and to translate it into English naturally. Two weeks.

rows: 12–14 hours · two weeks (weeks 104–105), plus the EGY track

blocks.text: Materials This unit, dictionary by root, Grammar G45, script for speech synthesis, session with tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. form the passive internal to perfect and imperfect, in form I and derived forms;
2. grant the passive verb with its subject ( ⁧نَائِبُ الفَاعِلِ⁩ );
3. recognize the passive in a text without vowels thanks to context;
4. recognizing the most frequent passives of weak verbs ( ⁧قِيلَ⁩ , ⁧يُقَالُ⁩ , ⁧وُجِدَ⁩ , ⁧يُوجَدُ⁩ , ⁧وُلِدَ⁩ , ⁧تُوُفِّيَ⁩ );
5. use impersonal liabilities and fixed expressions ( ⁧يُسْمَحُ بِـ⁩ , ⁧يُقَالُ إِنَّ⁩ , ⁧يُعَدُّ⁩ );
6. use and translate constructions with ⁧تَمَّ⁩ and ⁧جَرَى⁩ + maṣdar and the staff member, ⁧مِنْ قِبَلِ.⁩
Two-week plan.

2. What is the Arab passive

The Arab passive is used when the person who performs the action is unknown, obvious or not interested. That's why the Arabic grammar calls it ⁧المَبْنِيُّ لِلْمَجْهُولِ⁩ . The name that undergoes the action becomes the grammatical subject and goes to the name: it is called ⁧نَائِبُ الفَاعِلِ⁩ , is the substitute for the subject.
⁧يَسْتَخْدِمُ النَّاسُ هٰذِهِ الكَلِمَةَ.⁩ ⁧تُسْتَخْدَمُ هٰذِهِ الكَلِمَةُ.⁩ This word is used.

The agent is normally not here. In classical Arabic the passive and the agent are excluded: if you know who did the action, use the asset. The modern language, under the influence of European languages, sometimes adds the agent with ⁧مِنْ قِبَلِ⁩ (Section 9).
3. The forms of internal liabilities

The passive forms by changing the vowels, without adding letters. The rule. Perfect: u in the first syllable (and in all syllables before the last radical), before the last radical. Imperfect: prefix with u, before the last radical.

Comments. 1. In form III ā becomes ū: ⁧نَاقَشَ⁩ → ⁧نُوقِشَ⁩ . 2. In forms IV and II, the passive imperfect is distinguished from the active only for vowel before the last radical: ⁧يُرْسِلُ⁩ ... ⁧يُرْسَلُ⁩ It shall be sent. 3. Form VII has no passive value: it already has a passive or reflective value ( ⁧اِنْكَسَرَ⁩ It's broken. Forms V and VI have a rare passive, which you just recognize. 4. The passive unites in all people like the asset: ⁧كُتِبْتُ⁩ , ⁧كُتِبُوا⁩ , ⁧يُكْتَبُونَ⁩ ; to the conjunctive and juxtaposed: ⁧أَنْ يُكْتَبَ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يُكْتَبْ.⁩
4. The Agreement
The passive verb agrees with its subject ( ⁧نَائِبُ الفَاعِلِ⁩ ) as an active verb with its subject: to the singular if it precedes (A2), generally and number if followed.
⁧كُتِبَ التَّقْرِيرُ.⁩ The report was written.
⁧الطُّلَّابُ دُعُوا إِلَى الاِجْتِمَاعِ.⁩ Students were invited to the meeting.

⁧الطُّرُود⁩ • the packages (sing. ⁧طَرْد⁩ ) · ⁧أَعْضَاء⁩ (sing. ⁧عُضْو⁩ ). Subject goes to name. ⁧فُتِحَ البَابُ⁩ , ⁧البَابَ⁩ : what in the asset was the object complement is now subject. In the vociferous texts this is a valuable clue.

6. Recognizing the passive without vowels
Four clues, to use together.
1. There is no agent, and the name after the verb is something that suffers. ⁧أرسلت الطرود⁩ : packages not ship, are shipped → ⁧أُرْسِلَتِ الطُّرُودُ.⁩
2. The verb is at the beginning of a news, followed by a name of what and a complement of time or place.
⁧افتتح المعرض أمس⁩ → ⁧اُفْتُتِحَ المَعْرِضُ أَمْسِ⁩ The exhibition was inaugurated yesterday.
3. C'è ⁧مِنْ قِبَلِ⁩ , ⁧عَلَى يَدِ⁩ , ⁧مِنْ طَرَفِ⁩ : The agent is introduced by a preposition, so the verb is passive.

4. It is a fixed expression: ⁧يقال إن⁩ , ⁧يعتقد أن⁩ , ⁧يذكر أن⁩ , ⁧يرجى⁩ , ⁧يمنع⁩ , ⁧يوجد⁩ , ⁧يعد⁩ . These must be recognized as I'll be right there. Attention to the first person. ⁧كتبت⁩ may be ⁧كَتَبْتُ⁩ I wrote it down. ⁧كَتَبْتَ⁩ You wrote it. ⁧كَتَبَتْ⁩ She wrote and also ⁧كُتِبَتْ⁩ It has been written. The context (who speaks? is there an object?) decides.

8. Impersonal liabilities and fixed expressions

Verbs with preposition. If the verb holds a preposition, the passive remains to the singular male and the preposition remains: ⁧يُسْمَحُ بِالتَّدْخِينِ⁩ smoking is allowed (excl. smoking allowed), ⁧عُثِرَ عَلَى حَقِيبَةٍ⁩ A bag has been found. ⁧يُطْلَبُ مِنَ المُسَافِرِينَ⁩ The passenger is asked to do so.

9. The alternatives of newspapers and the agent
⁧تَمَّ⁩ / ⁧يَتِمُّ⁩ + maṣdar. The Word ⁧تَمَّ⁩ • to be fulfilled, to be followed by a maṣdar form a passive 'analytic', clear even without vowels.
⁧سَيُنَاقَشُ القَانُونُ.⁩ ⁧سَتَتِمُّ مُنَاقَشَةُ القَانُونِ.⁩ The law will be discussed.

The agreement of ⁧تَمَّ⁩ . The verb agrees with the maṣdar which follows: ⁧تَمَّ افْتِتَاحُ⁩ ... but ⁧تَمَّتْ مُنَاقَشَةُ⁩ …; In the newspapers there is often also male. Many grammarians consider ⁧تَمَّ⁩ a little elegant shortcut; Newspapers, administrations and news outlets use it all the time. You must recognize it and know how to use it; in your written texts alternate it with the internal passive. ⁧جَرَى⁩ + maṣdar has the same value, with a nuance of "slip": ⁧جَرَى تَوْقِيعُ الاِتِّفَاقِ فِي القَاهِرَةِ⁩ The agreement was signed in Cairo. Forms VII and V often express what we say in English with a passive or with a "yes": ⁧اِنْعَقَدَ المُؤْتَمَرُ⁩ The Congress was held, ⁧اِنْكَسَرَ الزُّجَاجُ⁩ The glass is broken, ⁧تَأَسَّسَتِ الشَّرِكَةُ عَامَ⁩ ... the company was founded in... The express agent. In the modern language: ⁧مِنْ قِبَلِ⁩ (the most common), ⁧مِنْ طَرَفِ⁩ (North Africa), ⁧عَلَى يَدِ⁩ • by the hand of a person, ⁧بِوَاسِطَةِ⁩ • by means of an instrument or intermediary. But if the agent is important, the best style is the asset: ⁧اِكْتَشَفَ فَرِيقٌ مِصْرِيٌّ المَقْبَرَةَ.⁩ How to translate into English. You have four possibilities: the liability ('was discovered'), the impersonal ('is said', 'is expected'), the assets with a generic subject ('they cancelled the flight'), a name ('the opening of the tomb') . Choose the most natural one for the type of text: in an Italian news, the passive and the ...si are normal.
10. Pronunciation

The sequence is the same. kutiba, fuṭiḥa, nūqiša, screaming, untuḫiba, ustuḫdima: practiced reading the perfect passive column of the section aloud 3, without slipping into the a of the asset. A of the imperfect. yuktabu, yursalu, yustaḫdamu. Couple to practice with the tutor: yursilu / yursalu, yunaẓẓimu / yunaẓẓamu, yastaḫdimu / yustaḫdamu: The tutor says a form, you say "active" or "passive." The fixed expressions. yuqālu inna, yuʿtaqadu Anna, yuḏkaru Anna, yuʿaddu: repeat them until they come out without thinking.
